title: Reader snapshot: items, board and readers JSON
description:
As a visitor, I want live numbers on static pages so that votes show without a rebuild.

Feature: Snapshot
  Scenario: Debounced snapshot after a vote
    Given a reader voted
    When the debounced reader-snapshot runs
    Then _data/reader/items.json, board.json and readers.json hold public-safe numbers
  Scenario: Hype gap needs n >= 5 on every dimension
  Scenario: No person id, siteSubject or email appears in any output (privacy scan)
